name: P-Image-OSS (Pruna, based on MiniMax-H3)

lineage.how_derived: Pruna's optimized variant: 8 steps without CFG, edit with up to 8 input images, ComfyUI components in bf16 / int8 / 4-bit w4a8 (card)

purpose: Image generation and editing from a 20 GB download (21 GB peak VRAM at 8 MP) versus 143 GB for MiniMax-H3 (card).

license.name: MiniMax-H3 Community License Agreement (cardData minimax-h3-community-license-agreement)
license.notes: Card tag points to the MiniMax-H3 community licence, whose text was read for the minimax-h3-image record: territory excludes EU, UK, Korea and USA; separate authorization above 1M USD revenue or when hosting as a service. The P-Image-OSS repo's own LICENSE file was not opened.

architecture.kind: MiniMax-H3 derived diffusion transformer (about 33B), Qwen3-VL-class text encoder, prompt upsampler (about 19 GB of LLM weights) and a 5.56 GB VAE in the diffusers repo

variants.notes: transformer 7 shards 66.3 GB, text encoder 8.9 GB, prompt upsampler 18.8 GB, VAE 5.6 GB (HF API); HF API reports 33.1B parameters; 382 likes
smallest set 20 GB download; repo total 139 GB for all formats; 1.27M downloads

pc-12gb.notes: card: from 21 GB VRAM at 8 MP

pc-16gb.notes: needs offload below 21 GB peak; speed not known

mac-32gb.notes: 22 GB GPU share vs 21 GB peak; quant format is ComfyUI/CUDA

strengths: edits with up to 8 reference images
soft.maturity: 1.27M downloads of the Comfy repo in three weeks (mostly through ComfyUI).

tona_fit.reason: The quantized H3 variant brings a 33B image model into the 24 GB class, but the MiniMax licence excludes the EU, UK and USA, so it cannot be offered to our users; see minimax-h3-image.

open_questions: Quality loss of w4a8/int8 versus bf16 not measured by anyone found
